title: Article 350A — Facilities for instruction in mother-tongue at primary stage

content.overview: Article 350A directs every State and every local authority within the State to endeavour to provide adequate facilities for instruction in the mother-tongue at the primary stage of education to children belonging to linguistic minority groups, and empowers the President to issue such directions to any State as he considers necessary or proper for securing the provision of such facilities.
content.glance: States and local authorities to endeavour to provide primary education in mother-tongue for linguistic minority children. President may issue directions to States.
content.study:
Article 350A (Seventh Amendment):
- Duty to endeavour: adequate facilities for mother-tongue instruction at primary stage for linguistic minority children.
- Addressed to every State and every local authority within the State.
- President may issue directions to any State to secure such facilities.

Examination: primary stage; mother-tongue; linguistic minorities; Presidential directions.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: States and local authorities shall endeavour to provide adequate facilities for mother-tongue instruction at the primary stage for linguistic minority children. President may direct States to secure such facilities.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 350A provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 350A provides that it shall be the endeavour of every State and of every local authority within the State to provide adequate facilities for instruction in the mother-tongue at the primary stage of education to children belonging to linguistic minority groups, and that the President may issue such directions to any State as he considers necessary or proper for securing the provision of such facilities.

keyTakeaways: Art 350A: mother-tongue instruction at primary stage for linguistic minorities.
